description.short_caption: Necrotic lesion on the finger with surrounding erythema.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a close-up view of a finger with a necrotic lesion on the dorsal surface near the distal phalanx. The lesion appears dark and necrotic, with a central eschar surrounded by erythema and mild swelling. The surrounding skin shows no obvious vesicles or pustules. The background includes a patterned medical gown, suggesting a clinical setting.
